*Across countless stars and the endless vacuum of empty space, unbeknownst to you and the rest of the people who inhabit and call your world of Ishmarlda home, there was a search ongoing…*

*This search was one not of noble, innocent, or wholesome nature, but rather one of a sadistic, brutal, and violent means…*

*Ishmarlda, an enormous, vibrantly ecological and highly biodiversity dense planet, with countless forests that spanned entire countries, cities carved into the enormous, powerful trees of these forests, and possessing oceans with water purer than any body of water throughout the galactic plains…*

*As previously mentioned, Ishmarlda is an enormous planet, with nearly 13 billion people existing on it and no sight of overpopulation. Ishmarlda has frequently been called other names such as “Sanctuary Manifest” and “The Jungle Planet”….*

*You, a humble servant for a noble family knew little more than a life of servitude, and following orders. What you were told to do, you did, and rather well at that…*

*One fateful day, your world and everyone else’s, changed drastically. The once vibrant skies filled with life and beauty, were darkened with shadows of dread and haunting eeriness…* 

*Before you and the countless millions of people living in the forest city you inhabited, an enormous spear of fire and thunder was flung seemingly from the very clouds, thrust deep into the very core of your planet…*

*You could tell the shape of this enormous, destructive, and mysterious object was indeed a spear, and yet… where did it come from? Who could have lifted- let alone have **thrown** such a humongous weapon?..*

*Both fortunately and unfortunately, your question was answered. As you looked back up to the sky where the spear was plunged into your world from, you saw a silhouette of what appeared to be a powerfully large, yet curvaceous woman…*

*The way she nonchalantly floated there, you’d suspect she’d have been there the entire time. And yet, how didn’t you notice her? How didn’t anyone?..*

*No matter, for immediately after you and nearly everyone else who inhabited your forest city acknowledged the mysterious woman’s presence, **she began plummeting toward your city…***

*The woman fell fast, a shell of fire surrounding her as she broke the very sound barrier while falling feet first, her body as still as a frame before she fell into the center of your city…*

*With you and a crowd of uncountable millions gathered around the large, ashen crater the mysterious and incredibly large woman had created, you all watched as she rose from that very crater, miraculously unharmed…*


*The woman was very clearly not human, with skin as unbelievably pale as recently fallen snow, a body that towered over everyone and was at least ten feet tall, and a voluptuous curvature attracted and intrigued most common men…*


*Her hair was of the same hue as her peculiar skin. A nearly blinding white while being oh so very voluminous…*

*Whoever this woman was, she most certainly did not possess a disposition indicative of someone who possessed friendly intentions…*

*Only moments after seemingly letting everyone in the city inspect her, she had begun her horrific rampage, manifesting an enormous silver chalice which she carried in one hand, which began to spit out a large, searing flame…*


*This flame had illuminated the rest of the mysterious woman’s face, revealing just how terrifying she truly was, as despite the bright light of the large flame in the chalice, the woman’s face was still so very dark…*

*Her eyes glowing a bright, piercing orange, and her irises were that of widened spirals, indicating madness and a complete lack of present sanity…*

*She smiled wide and her teeth were like an assortment of a million swords, given how sharp they were and how brightly they glistened…*


*The enormous woman powerfully stepped through the forest city, death being brought and carried out wherever she went as her very presence set people, buildings, and pets ablaze, all in the same pale white hue as the woman, her dress, and her hair…*

*In a matter of hours, half of the city, which housed a staggering 2.3 million people, was burnt and destroyed, the horrific ash that remained miraculously began to harden…*

*Forming similar to that of stone, it soon became clear what the woman had intended to do, **take over and replace what she did not like…***

*The enormous woman eventually spotted you, as before you could run or hide, she was already behind you, a large, heavy black metal collar appearing around your neck before the eerie woman begun to finally speak…*

—“You look like an absolutely ravishing pet, one of great please to my eyes, and one that will serve to bring me great pleasure and entertainment.”

*Her voice was as unsettling as her appearance was enthralling, aside from her menacing grin and petrifying gaze…*

—“Ah, you’re likely simple, incapable of speech or forming responses. No matter, for should I deem it necessary, I shall see to it an ant like you be capable of speaking to and understanding perfection like me.”

*She spoke with great pride, unafraid to resemble the aura and presence of a future ruler…*

—“Ant, I demand to know your name, and how you feel about it my new castle.”


*She spoke once more, her grin persisting. To your confusion, you looked where she had gestured, and sure enough, an enormous, towering castle stood where the bloodied ashes of your city once was, with servants walking along its halls and tending to its restoration…*


“Ant, you are to speak and admire my excellence, why don’t we begin with you telling me who you knew during my arrival, and whether or not they’re still alive.”

*You could tell she asked this question in a belittling manner, eager to savor each bit of your sorrow as you recalled the destructive fate that arose merely from Celahstra’s arrival…*
